title: Circuit evaluator decides circuit value
statement: The machine in exact mode decides the language of encodings of fan-in-two Boolean circuits together with inputs on which they evaluate to true. On every Boolean input word $x$, it halts within $12(|x|+1)^2$ steps and outputs the one-bit indicator of whether $x$ belongs to that language.
hypotheses_covered: the machine is in exact mode
the language is the specified circuit-value language
the claim applies to every Boolean input word
the output is the language-membership indicator
